summary: Wave 12 — Punto Cero One backend end-to-end validation against the PUBLIC URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://future-core-5.preview.emergentagent.com). Executed pytest 55/55 GREEN (test_wave12_final 21 + test_wave12_groups_ext 4 + test_wave12_ux 6 + test_wave12_content_sources 7 + test_wave7_growth 17). Additionally ran ad-hoc curl smoke against all vertical endpoints listed in the review (13 endpoints — every one returns 200 with non-empty payload) and confirmed OAuth cleanup + mixed-feed variety. No backend issues found.

verifications.registration: POST /api/community/auth/register creates session (verified via test_wave12_ux::TestProfileMedia::test_avatar_upload_delete_flow, test_cover_upload_flow, and test_wave12_groups_ext — all use ad-hoc registration and get 200 + session cookie).
verifications.oauth_providers_cleanup: GET /api/community/auth/providers returns enabled=[google, linkedin, facebook] and coming_soon=[] (EMPTY). Apple/Microsoft/GitHub/Twitter completely absent — verified via test_wave12_ux::TestOAuthCleanupRegression::test_providers_only_shows_visible_v1 + live curl.
verifications.mixed_feed_variety: GET /api/content-sources/mixed-feed?limit=20 → 7 distinct kinds present (user_post:5, news:4, video:4, job:3, company:2, event:1, repo:1). Max consecutive same-kind = 1 (well below 4-repeat anti-repetition threshold). Verified by pytest test_mixed_feed_variety_and_anti_repetition + live curl.
verifications.profile_media: PUT/DELETE /api/community/users/me/media/{picture,cover} — upload returns persistent URL, delete clears field, non-image returns 415. All 5 tests in TestProfileMedia GREEN.
verifications.composer_upload_real: POST /api/feed/media/upload returns {ok,url}; subsequent POST /api/feed/posts with image_url persists; GET /api/feed/posts/{id} returns image_url. TestComposerUploadReal 4/4 GREEN.
verifications.vertical_endpoints_live: All 13 endpoints in the review returned HTTP 200 against public URL: /api/growth/feed(24KB), /api/growth/connectors(17KB), /api/feed/posts(10KB), /api/feed/trending(205B), /api/content-sources/videos(3KB), /api/content-sources/ai-tools(3KB), /api/content-sources/by-type/jobs?country=CO(1.6KB), /api/content-sources/by-type/events?country=CO(1.3KB), /api/companies(19KB), /api/groups(4KB), /api/search?q=test(6.9KB), /api/community/stats(109B), /api/content-sources/mixed-feed?limit=8(4.9KB).
verifications.groups_crud: TestGroupsCRUD::test_categories_endpoint (10 categories present: marketing, empleo, empresas, tecnologia, legal, salud, educacion, marketplace, contabilidad, emprendimiento), test_full_group_lifecycle (create → join → post w/ membership guard 403 → list posts/members), test_list_groups_filtered_by_category — all GREEN.
verifications.group_notifications: test_join_notifies_admin (kind='group_join' delivered to admin, not to joiner) + test_post_notifies_all_other_members (kind='group_post' to all members except author) — both GREEN.
verifications.group_cover_admin_only: TestGroupCover::test_admin_uploads_and_deletes_cover (admin PUT returns URL, GET group includes cover_url, DELETE clears it) + test_cover_upload_requires_auth (401/403 for non-admin) — GREEN.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend surface is stable — 55 pytest cases + 13 live vertical endpoints all healthy. No 500s, no empty payloads.

OAuth providers correctly cleaned up at the API layer (enabled=3, coming_soon=[]) — Apple/Microsoft/GitHub/Twitter are neither enabled nor advertised as coming_soon. This is a regression-worthy behavior; keep test_wave12_ux::test_providers_only_shows_visible_v1 in the CI gate.

Mixed-feed anti-repetition is well-tuned: with limit=20 the longest run of same-kind items is 1, indicating the shuffling strategy is diverse enough. Kind distribution across 20 items includes 7 distinct kinds (user_post, news, video, job, company, event, repo) — matches spec.
Nit (non-blocking): /api/community/stats payload is very small (109 B). Consider verifying it exposes counts (users, posts, groups) for the landing page — a future test could enforce specific keys.

success_rate.backend: 100% (55/55 pytest + 13/13 live vertical endpoints + 100% ad-hoc providers/mixed-feed curl checks)
success_rate.frontend: not tested (backend-only scope per review request)
